fees.feeNotes: £2 a month. Pays £4 a month in Rewards for 2+ Direct Debits of at least £2. That reward is not linked to card spending.

rules.description: No reward on everyday debit card spending (only MyRewards partner offers earn)

verification.notes: No foreign transaction fees on debit card spend abroad (not ATMs). Network (Visa) not stated on the page.
